## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no credentials, private state, or personal handoffs.
- [ ] Focused tests and `git diff --check` pass.
- [ ] Applicable complete and host-specific gates are reported honestly.
- [ ] Canonical documentation is updated for changed contracts.
- [ ] Generated assets are current.
- [ ] External commits include a DCO sign-off.
